item.title: Ask Murph for a group chat by name or people
item.summary: From your private Murph, you can now ask about or share into an existing joined iMessage group by its chat name or by the people in it.
item.details: Murph uses only your own shared Contacts when available. Otherwise it offers limited clues such as area code and last four digits, and it asks before acting whenever more than one group could match. New joined groups also keep their existing iMessage title when one is available.
